frequency_question: How often do national union coalitions with strike mandates initiate indefinite strikes within 46 days of issuing strike notices?
membership_rule: Includes multi-union industry coalitions that have balloted for and announced intentions for indefinite strikes; excludes single-employer wildcat strikes or negotiations without formal strike authorization.
